endpoints.name: visitorProfile
endpoints.description: Intuit marketing enrichment for this visitor: household demographics + firmographic signals (Service Integration Payload).

inputs.name: accountId
inputs.description: Intuit visitor account id (from the of1_profile cookie)

output.description: Raw Intuit Service Integration Payload (org SBSEG / scope QBO / purpose MKTG). Nested envelope: marketingProfile.{neustar,zoominfo}.attributes[] are {attributeName, attributeValue} pairs; marketingProfile.aep.segments are RTCDP audience UUIDs. The field guide below explains the meaningful attributeName values.

fields.length_of_residence: neustar: length of residence at current address (years)
fields.marketingProfile.aep.segments: RTCDP/AJO audience segment UUIDs the visitor belongs to (buying-group role, IES Trial, etc.); resolve names via of1/config/audiences.json
